info.title: Qdrant Serverless Collections API

servers.description: Endpoint of your serverless space, as shown in Qdrant Cloud.

space_endpoint.description: The URL of the serverless space, without a trailing slash.

get.description: Lists the caller's collections, newest first, one page at a time. Pass the `next_page_offset` of a page as `offset` to fetch the following one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as `next_page_offset` by the previous page. Omit for the first page. Clients must not interpret this value.

time.description: Time spent to process this request, in seconds.

get.description: Returns the configuration the collection was created with and its current statistics.

time.description: Time spent to process this request, in seconds.

put.description:
Creates a collection with the given tenant-facing configuration. At least one dense or sparse vector is required.

The operation is idempotent on the name: if a collection with this name already exists it is left untouched and the response carries `created: false`.

single_dense.description: The simplest collection: one unnamed dense vector, exact (`high`) precision, no payload indexes.

hybrid.description: Named dense and sparse vectors for hybrid search, a cheaper `medium` precision tier for the dense embeddings, IDF weighting for the BM25 sparse vector, and a few payload indexes for filtering.

multivector.description: A ColBERT / ColPali style collection: each point stores several sub-vectors that are compared with max-sim. Aggressive `low` precision keeps the many sub-vectors cheap.

time.description: Time spent to process this request, in seconds.

delete.description: Deletes the collection and all of its data. Irreversible.

result.description: `true` once the collection and its data are deleted.

time.description: Time spent to process this request, in seconds.

get.summary: Check the existence of a collection
get.description: Returns `true` if a collection with the given name exists, `false` otherwise. Unlike `GET /collections/{collection_name}` this never answers 404.

time.description: Time spent to process this request, in seconds.

api-key.name: api-key
api-key.description: Space API key, created in Qdrant Cloud for this serverless space.

bearerAuth.description: The same space API key, passed as a bearer token.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or the configuration is invalid, e.g. no vectors at all, a `limit` above 100, or an unknown `distance`.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing or does not grant access to this space.

NotFound.description: No collection with this name exists in the space.

Distance.description: Distance metric used to compare dense vectors. Same values as the Qdrant server API.

PrecisionTier.description:
How much of the original vector precision may be traded for cost.

- `low`: aggressive compression, lowest cost, approximate results.
- `medium`: moderate compression with a small accuracy trade-off.
- `high`: no lossy compression, exact stored vectors (default).

The serverless manager turns the tier into a concrete quantization and datatype choice; scalar, product or binary quantization and their parameters are never chosen directly.

DenseVectorConfig.description: Configuration of a single dense (embedding) vector.

multivector.description: Store several sub-vectors per point and compare them with max-sim, for late-interaction models (ColBERT, ColPali, ...). Default: false.

VectorsConfig.description:
Dense vectors of the collection, in one of two shapes, as in the Qdrant server API.

A single unnamed vector:

```json
{ "size": 1536, "distance": "Cosine" }
```

or several named vectors:

```json
{ "text": { "size": 1536, "distance": "Cosine" }, "image": { "size": 512, "distance": "Dot" } }
```

A collection has either the single unnamed vector or named ones, never both.

anyOf.description: Named dense vectors, keyed by vector name.

Modifier.description:
Weight modification applied to sparse vectors at query time.

- `none`: no modification (default).
- `idf`: inverse document frequency, based on statistics of the collection. Enable for BM25-style models.

SparseVectorConfig.description: Configuration of a single sparse vector.

PayloadIndexType.description:
Kind of filter a payload field supports. Use the bare name when the index needs no options, e.g. `"user_id": "keyword"`.

- `keyword`: exact match on strings, e.g. `color: "red"`.
- `integer`: exact match and range filters on integers, e.g. `age: 25`.
- `float`: range filters on floating point (and integer) numbers, e.g. `price: 99.5`.
- `uuid`: exact match on UUID strings; like `keyword` but stored compactly.
- `datetime`: range filters on RFC 3339 datetimes, e.g. `created_at: "2023-02-08T10:49:00Z"`.
- `text`: full-text filtering on strings.
- `geo`: radius, bounding box and polygon filters on `{ lon, lat }` values.
- `bool`: exact match on booleans, e.g. `is_active: true`.

KeywordIndexParams.description: Exact match on string values, e.g. `color: "red"`.

prefix.description: Enable prefix matching (`match: { "prefix": ... }`) on this field. Default: false.

IntegerIndexParams.description: Exact match and/or range filters on integers, e.g. `age: 25`. Both are on by default; turning one off shrinks the index.

FloatIndexParams.description: Range filters on floating point (and integer) numbers, e.g. `price: 99.5`.

UuidIndexParams.description: Exact match on UUID strings; like `keyword` but stored compactly.

DatetimeIndexParams.description: Range filters on RFC 3339 datetimes, e.g. `created_at: "2023-02-08T10:49:00Z"`.

GeoIndexParams.description: Geo radius, bounding box and polygon filters on `{ lon, lat }` values.

BoolIndexParams.description: Exact match on booleans, e.g. `is_active: true`.

Tokenizer.description:
Full-text tokenizer. Same values as the Qdrant server API.

- `prefix`: index every prefix of each token.
- `whitespace`: split on whitespace (default).
- `word`: split on word boundaries.
- `multilingual`: language-aware tokenization.

Language.description: Language name as accepted by the Qdrant server API, lowercase, e.g. `english`, `german`, `spanish`.

StopwordsSet.description: Tokens ignored by a full-text index. Predefined language lists and custom tokens are merged.

languages.description: Languages whose predefined stopword lists to apply.

custom.description: Extra stopwords to ignore, merged with the language lists.

Stopwords.description: Tokens to ignore at index and query time. Either a single language name, e.g. `"english"`, or a set combining several languages and custom tokens.

SnowballParams.description: Snowball stemmer for the given language.

DisabledStemmerParams.description: Explicitly disable stemming (overrides any language default).

StemmingAlgorithm.description: Stemming algorithm for a full-text index. Unset: no stemming.

lowercase.description: Lowercase text before indexing. Default: true.

phrase_matching.description: Support phrase queries; builds extra index structure. Default: true.

ascii_folding.description: Fold accented characters to ASCII (e.g. `ação` -> `acao`). Default: false.

PayloadIndexParams.description: A payload index with options. `type` selects the kind of filter the field supports.

PayloadIndexConfig.description:
One payload index, as in the Qdrant server API: either the bare index type, e.g. `"keyword"`, or an object with options, e.g. `{ "type": "text", "tokenizer": "word" }`.

Only the kind of filter the field supports is chosen here; storage placement of the index is the manager's decision.

CollectionConfig.description:
The tenant-facing configuration of a collection. Unlike the Qdrant server API it is deliberately small: the serverless manager turns it into concrete Qdrant settings (HNSW, quantization, storage placement, ...), which are never exposed.

At least one dense or sparse vector is required.

sparse_vectors.description: Sparse vectors, keyed by vector name.

payload_indexes.description: Payload indexes, keyed by payload field name (a JSON path, e.g. `user_id` or `meta.tags`).

CreateCollectionResult.description: Outcome of a create. Creating a collection that already exists is not an error: `created` is `false` and the existing collection is left untouched.

created.description: `true` if the collection was created by this request, `false` if it already existed.

CollectionInfo.description: Configuration and statistics of a collection.

points_count.description: Number of available points as of the last applied write (eventually consistent). `null` until the first statistics have been collected for the collection.
Number of available points as of the last applied write (eventually consistent). `null` until the first statistics have been collected for the collection.

CollectionsResponse.description: A page of the caller's collections.

next_page_offset.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `offset` to retrieve the next page. `null` when there are no more results. Clients must not interpret this value.

time.description: Time spent to process this request, in seconds.
